title: Roadmap
html:
M0 — PoC (this repo) ✅

  • choice / noul / score decisions with typed examples, validated at definition
  • match with compile-time exhaustiveness and a required uncertain arm; at() guards
  • Escalation chain, decideAll with per-tier batching
  • Backends: builtin() (trained from examples, calibrated), jet() (HTTP /v1/decide), nodd() (wraps @nodd/node), fn()
  • verdict build / check / eval / label CLI, .verdict/ artifacts
  • JSONL trace
  • Examples: comment moderation (1,711 rows from Nodd), support triage with decideAll
  • Tests: runtime (node:test) + type tests (tsc with @ts-expect-error)

M0.5 — Own syntax ✅

  • .vd lexer, parser, checker (exhaustive match, label checks, types), interpreter
  • Guarded fall-through arms (high @ 0.8 => … then high => …)
  • verdict run | check, and build/eval/label/questions accept .vd
  • VS Code syntax highlighting (editors/vscode)
  • Language server: diagnostics from the checker, hover shows a decision's labels
  • Records/structs, else in match for non-decision values, modules (import "x.vd")
  • Compile .vd to TypeScript (same runtime) instead of interpreting

M1 — Real stack end to end

  • Run examples/ against a live Jet (local jet-serve or the HF Space)
  • verdict label → nodd run → nodd() tier: one script that distills a decision from Jet into a Nodd model and wires it into the chain
  • Check that Jet's choice keys and Nodd's labels match the decision at load (done for Nodd; add a dry-run for Jet)

M2 — React

  • useDecision(D, input) hook: debounced, suspense-friendly, runs builtin/nodd in a worker, escalates to Jet through the app's own endpoint (keys stay server-side)
  • <Decide on={…}> with typed render props per label + uncertain

M3 — Learning loop

  • verdict retrain: take escalated cases from the trace, label them with the top tier, add to the examples, rebuild, show the metric diff, fail CI on regression
  • Per-decision drift alarm: share of escalations over time

M4 — Language

  • TS compiler plugin / ESLint rule: flag decide() results used without match
  • Optional .verdict syntax compiling to the TS embedding, if the TS form hits limits
  • Policy arms: @ p > 0.9 sugar, cost budgets per decision (maxTier: "nodd" in the browser)
